integrity: The complete proof uses exact binary valuations and Lucas congruence; finite checker is reproducible corroboration, not proof. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
limitations: Prime-index equality is proved only for primes above eight.
No claim about infinitely many Jacobsthal or Fermat primes.
Classical carry and digit-sum foundations; hidden prior specialization risk.
scientific_limitations: Only eightfold threshold and (for GCD equality) prime multipliers above eight; does not classify composite GCDs, show infinitude of exceptional primes, or establish independent priority.
title: Complete eightfold binomial saturation profiles and sharp exceptional counts
